category.reason: The target is the narrow vertical line marking the current playback position inside the progress bar, requiring a precise point along the timeline.

instruction.en: Locate the current progress on the video progress bar.
instruction.zh: 定位视频进度条上的当前进度。

reference.patch: Added instruction.zh by translating the original English instruction. Adjusted groundTruth from [1197.0, 443.0, 1453.0, 408.0] to [1197.0, 440.0, 1505.0, 405.0] in [top, right, bottom, left] pixel coordinates, centering the box on the playback-position line and extending its lower edge to cover the whole line. Classified category.item as Small Target.
